result.headline: Actuator channel 1 (roll loop) froze at 1500 us from 63.483 s; pitch tracking degraded afterwards.
result.explanation: Channel 1, which served the roll loop, stopped varying at 63.483 s and held 1500 us to the end. Pitch tracking got worse shortly after. The recording cannot show whether the output stage, the controller or the logging stopped.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[1]] was varying, then held 1500 from t=63.483 s to the end of the recording (12.666 s, 40 samples)
evidence.shows: Channel 1 was moving, then froze with no event or mode change. The other channels kept moving.

evidence.quote: ROLE actuator.output[ch[1]] follows control.attitude_setpoint[roll] (correlation -0.683 over the recording): it serves that loop
evidence.shows: Channel 1 is the roll-loop output. Before the freeze it followed the roll setpoint at -0.79 correlation (-0.858 at 0.648 s lag).

evidence.quote: ANOMALY a9 t=64.033 s: vehicle.attitude[pitch] followed control.attitude_setpoint[pitch] worse for good (typical |error| 1.528 -> 6.696) (see line 76; strength 2.334)
evidence.shows: Pitch tracking error roughly doubled right after the freeze (ratio 2.15 in compare at 64.033 s), while roll and yaw tracking did not change.

evidence.quote: ANOMALY a11 t=69.765 s: vehicle.attitude[pitch] changed level for good (-0.666 -> -11.92 deg) (see line 37; strength 1.712)
evidence.shows: Pitch ended at -20.36 deg at 75.961 s while the pitch setpoint level moved to 11.215 deg. The loop is not following.

checked.check: compare at the freeze time: what changed
checked.result: Only channel 1 froze (spread 13.0 -> 0.0). Roll and yaw tracking ratios were 0.84 and 0.9. Pitch tracking ratio was 2.04.

checked.check: Was channel 1 following the roll loop before the freeze (relation, 10.051 to 63.376 s)
checked.result: Correlation -0.79, -0.858 at a 0.648 s lag. The output was alive and tracking until the freeze.
checked.about: Freeze is a fault, not a normal hold

checked.result: Roll setpoint, pitch, roll and channel 1 all left baseline at 55.049 s or 55.056 s. This is a manoeuvre: the roll setpoint went from 41.7 to -13.68. Channel 1 froze later.
Only 2 events, both at t=0.148 s (low-voltage warning, sensor health error). Nothing is logged at 63.483 s.

checked.check: Roll response after the freeze (window 60.0 to 76.0 s)
checked.result: With channel 1 held at 1500, roll still followed its setpoint: at 75.333 s the setpoint was 41.96 and roll was 42.739. Roll tracking ratio was 1.06.
checked.about: Roll-loop loss from the frozen channel

effects.quote: ANOMALY a9 t=64.033 s: vehicle.attitude[pitch] followed control.attitude_setpoint[pitch] worse for good (typical |error| 1.528 -> 6.696) (see line 76; strength 2.334)
effects.why: It follows the freeze closely in time. It may be a consequence, or a separate pitch-loop problem; this data cannot say which.

effects.quote: ANOMALY a11 t=69.765 s: vehicle.attitude[pitch] changed level for good (-0.666 -> -11.92 deg) (see line 37; strength 1.712)
effects.why: Late pitch divergence, probably a consequence of degraded control after the freeze.

outcomes.means: The controller or mixer stopped commanding. Look for a failsafe, limit or saturation state.

unknowns: Who or what commanded channel 1 to hold 1500 at 63.483 s. The recording does not show it.
Whether the later pitch divergence is caused by the freeze or is an independent pitch-loop fault.
Whether the aircraft has a roll actuator other than channel 1, given that roll tracked normally with channel 1 frozen.

unobservable.fact: Servo, linkage and wiring condition on channel 1
unobservable.why_it_matters: A physical output or servo fault cannot be seen in commanded or logged signals.
unobservable.how_to_observe: Inspect the servo, connector and harness, and bench-test the channel for response to commanded PWM.

hypotheses.claim: The channel 1 output driver or servo path stopped following its command at the freeze.
hypotheses.because: Only channel 1 froze, with no event. It was tracking the roll loop at -0.858 correlation before. Controller-side and logging causes remain open.

hypotheses.claim: The controller or mixer stopped commanding channel 1, holding neutral without logging an event.
hypotheses.because: A held 1500 is a typical neutral or hold value. No mode change is logged, and the commanded value is not separately recorded.

hypotheses.claim: The channel 1 value was only logged as frozen while the aircraft output kept moving.
hypotheses.because: Roll still tracked normally after the freeze, which fits a logging artefact. It also fits another roll actuator.

hypotheses.claim: A separate pitch-loop degradation at about 64 s explains the pitch errors, independent of channel 1.
hypotheses.because: Pitch tracking worsened by ratio 2.15 at 64.033 s, soon after the freeze. Roll and yaw tracking did not change.

events.what: Low-voltage warning and sensor-health error at start-up
events.why: Start-up messages, with no later change pointing back to them.
The output was varying and froze while the other channels kept moving.

events.what: Pitch tracking degradation and divergence after the freeze
events.why: It begins soon after the freeze and may be a consequence of degraded control.

events.what: Level changes in roll setpoint, roll and velocity
